resolution.note: Refresh runs under flock, fetch retries ref/index lock errors, a failed refresh after merge reports merged with a warning

title: Parallel ships do not race the product-release refresh or git ref locks
body:
Why: Qwen second audit .krn/runs/qwen-research-2/report.md N4 (ship/wait part), verified at 6d713ae: refreshAfterMerge in src/ci/wait.ts runs scripts/product-release.sh without a lock, so two lanes merging together race in .krn/product-release and one exits 78 after its PR merged; git fetch in src/ci/ship.ts has no retry on ref-lock errors.
Outcome: the release refresh runs under an exclusive lock; transient git lock errors (ref lock, index.lock) are retried a bounded number of times; a 78 after a merged PR reports merged with a warning.
Proof: tests in test/ci/ for concurrent refresh and a simulated ref-lock retry.
